verdict.rationale: Riveter is a web scraping and enrichment platform, so a marketplace for publishing and monetizing custom scrapers is a fair axis for this kind of product. The evidence pack documents scrapes, enrichments, SDKs, webhooks and MCP connectivity. Nothing in it mentions a public marketplace, publishing user-built scrapers, or revenue sharing.

support.subject: As a developer, I can publish my custom scraper to a public marketplace and earn revenue when others use it
